acceptanceCriteria: Each child case is reproduced under a saturating load (or bounded by a recorded count of passing runs) and its outcome recorded per child id.

Each reproduced test-timing case waits on the condition it needs, or uses an injected clock or a deadline scaled without weakening what is asserted; budget assertions that measure performance report a retained measurement instead of failing under shared-host load.
Every case that turns out to be a product defect (for example a real survivor in V1-0768, or the V1-0771 race) is filed or linked as its own ticket, not closed here.
The repaired tests pass 20 consecutive runs under a saturating load.
body:
Umbrella for load- and timing-sensitive test failures, merged 2026-10-06 at the owner's request from 19 tickets, which are archived with a pointer here. Each child's original record (reproduction, host, load, revision, failure text) stays readable with `corvint-tasks ticket show <id>`; read it before working that case.

Children (test and observed failure):
- V1-0226: benchmarks/runner and internal/behaviorfalsify each failed once under load (test names not retained)
- V1-0455: TestExperimentalKernelAdapterContext: 250 ms kernel deadline
- V1-0636: liveverify/affected TestSelectionOnTheLiveDirtyWorktree: 100 ms select budget (343.5 ms observed)
- V1-0638: cmd/corvint TestWorkActualProducerInterruptedScratchCleanup: 1 ms poll can miss the producer's scratch window (CI, #434)
- V1-0724: tasks/store PSR pool-sweep and reconcile/dispatch tests are load-sensitive (general)
- V1-0727: a liveverify wall-clock budget test (name not retained)
- V1-0736: lspstdio TestWorkspaceBranchRootAndHealthy: Overlay definition unavailable at load 45-130
- V1-0738: tasks/authority TestGH494PreparationAdmission: 100 ms LOCK_TIMEOUT under full-suite load
- V1-0762: cmd/corvint TestHostAdapterJavaScriptHosts fails at ~60 s in a loaded run
- V1-0763: liveverify/affected TestIncrementalSelectionMeetsTheLiveBudget: p95 173 ms against 100 ms
- V1-0764: opencodequalification TestPassiveWitnessSettle/AHI-032: live descendant at the settle deadline
- V1-0766: tracerecordrepo TestAggregateOutcomeNativeAdmissionSizes/513: TempDir RemoveAll (.git not empty), 2/5 runs
- V1-0768: tasks/cli TestATRV0004_InterruptStopsTheRun: SURVIVORS, 2/15 on base ce4ae150 (real survivor not excluded)
- V1-0774: integrations/host-adapters.test.mjs:812 AHI-032: ESRCH asserted before the killed child is reaped
- V1-0779: tasks/store TestPSRRequestConflictAndOrphan/live-unknown-gone: 'new explicit request never executed', 2/8
- V1-0794: dispatch TestCALV0053_ReaderExpiredBeforeRetirement: 50 ms deadline, then nil cmd.Process panic in cleanup (confirmed test defect)
- V1-0796: tasks/store TestPSRSweepSuccessReplaySuccessor 'not freed' 2/3 in isolation; TestPSROrphanEarlyInitializationCleanup also reported
- V1-0815: tasks/store TestCALV0074_HostSwitchAndRollback: MALFORMED program transition under load (same symptom as V1-0771)
- V1-0817: tasks/store TestCALV0078_SupervisedRunAfterCommitIsNotRetryable: implementer ends BLOCKED_RECOVERY/MALFORMED under load (same symptom as V1-0771)

Common pattern: a wall-clock budget, poll interval, lock timeout or settle deadline in a test trips when the host is saturated (load averages 40-200 from parallel agent gates), and the test passes alone. The release candidates run `make gate` on a loaded release host, so these failures can fail a candidate without a product regression.

Not merged, still open separately: V1-0771 (suspected product race behind the MALFORMED program-transition refusals; V1-0815 and V1-0817 are its symptoms), V1-0825 and V1-0831 (unlocked-read races), V1-0703 (mixed clock in a fixture), V1-0665 (pre-lock map read), V1-0582 (bounded-blob fixture startup), V1-0662 (detached Git writers in fixtures), V1-0391 and V1-0397 (rc.2 fix lanes). A case found to be a product defect while working this umbrella gets its own ticket.
title: Test reliability umbrella: load- and timing-sensitive test failures (merges 19 flake tickets)
